children: The consumer care company brings in a seasoned marketing leader with over two decades of experience at Johnson & Johnson and Kenvue

Vini Cosmetics, the company behind Fogg deodorants and other personal care brands, has appointed Manoj Gadgil as its chief executive officer, bringing an experienced consumer goods executive to the helm.

Gadgil joins the company after serving as Business Unit Head and Vice President of Marketing at Kenvue from May 2023 to March 2026. Before that, he spent more than two decades at Johnson & Johnson in leadership roles spanning marketing, sales, brand management and business operations across India and Asia Pacific.

During his career, Gadgil worked with brands including Neutrogena, Clean & Clear, Johnson’s Baby, Band-Aid and Savlon. His experience includes leading the Asia Pacific femcare business, overseeing brand strategy, innovation and communications, as well as managing beauty and personal care categories in India.
He holds a postgraduate diploma in management, specialising in marketing, from the Indian Institute of Management Calcutta, and a bachelor’s degree in polymer engineering from Pune University.
Gadgil succeeds Krishnan Sundaram, who left Vini Cosmetics in August 2026 to join Bajaj Electricals as Chief Growth and New Business Officer.
